name: Gemini Claude Skills
headline: Gemini Claude Skills - Automate Workflows
short_description: Gemini Claude Skills integrate Google's Gemini 3 Pro models into workflows. Operations teams use it to automate tasks, generate images, and enhance productivity. Connects to Claude agents for execution.
author: stared

sections.overview:
Gemini Claude Skills connects Google's Gemini 3 Pro models directly to Claude Code, enabling two core capabilities: advanced image generation via the Nano Banana Pro model, and real-time AI consultation with web search grounding. The Nano Banana Pro skill generates infographics, maps, and detailed visualizations with configurable resolutions up to 4K and multiple aspect ratios. The Gemini Consultant skill provides second opinions on code, architecture, and analysis tasks while pulling live web information through Google Search integration. Both skills support vision analysis for image inputs. Installation requires only a Google AI API key and works automatically within Claude Code workflows.
Generate data-driven infographics and cartographic visualizations
Get real-time web-grounded second opinions on code and architecture decisions
Analyze screenshots and images with Gemini's vision capabilities
Create marketing visuals and presentations at multiple resolutions
Gemini 3 Pro will be integrated into [COMPANY]'s workflow to automate [TASK 1], [TASK 2], and [TASK 3]. This integration will enhance productivity and streamline operations.
